title: Valid Parentheses
statement_short: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid. Open brackets must be closed by the same type of brackets in the correct LIFO order.
constraints: 1 <= s.length <= 10^4, s consists of parentheses characters only '()[]{}'
hint: String length up to 10^4 demands an O(n) single pass, pushing open brackets to match closing counterparts.
why_not: Right: Stack pushes open bracket symbols and pops to verify matching closing symbols in exact LIFO order in O(n) time and O(n) space. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Using a hash set tracks character frequencies but loses crucial nested bracket ordering. Not Two Pointers: Inward or forward scanning with two pointers cannot validate arbitrarily deep nested bracket pairs. Not Sliding Window: Bracket validation requires dynamic push-pop nesting checks rather than evaluating a contiguous subsegment window.
